title: 10 August 1963: Live: Springfield Ballroom, Jersey
content:
The Beatles concluded their five nights of concerts in the Channel Islands with a fourth concert at Jersey’s Springfield Ballroom on 10 August 1963.

Their total earnings for the trip were £1,000.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2016: Paul McCartney live: Verizon Center, Washington, DC
  • 2014: Paul McCartney live: Dodger Stadium, Los Angeles
  • 2003: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: WE Fest, Detroit Lakes
  • 2001: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Etess Arena, Atlantic City
  • 1979: UK single release: Seaside Woman by Suzy And The Red Stripes
  • 1979: US single release: Arrow Through Me by Wings
  • 1977: Editing: Mull Of Kintyre by Wings
  • 1974: Travel: John Lennon – Los Angeles to Nederland
  • 1973: Recording: Mind Games by John Lennon
  • 1972: Paul and Linda McCartney and Denny Seiwell are arrested for cannabis possession
  • 1972: Wings live: Scandinavium, Gothenburg
  • 1968: Paul McCartney is interviewed for New Musical Express
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Riverboat Shuffle, MV Royal Iris, River Mersey
  • 1961: The Beatles live: St John’s Hall, Liverpool
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
